figure.rendering: local XeLaTeX; editable vector PDF and PNG preview

panels.meaning: The scoring path is reused during training and inference. Choose exactly one model adapter.

sample.meaning: Query/context and candidates with stable IDs; IDs are not tokenized into the model input.

compiler.meaning: Adapter-specific tokenization, logical positions, pairs or dense tree layout, eager or SDPA execution.

base.meaning: Qwen3 AutoModel without an LM head.

head.meaning: Last valid relevance-suffix state, followed by independent Linear/GELU/Linear scalar head.

yesno.meaning: Read existing LM-head yes/no rows at the last valid suffix token; subtract no logit from yes logit.

scores.meaning: One raw scalar per candidate, retaining the input order and ID association.

panels.meaning: Supervised learning and optional ranking validation selection; best and final are separate portable exports.

objective.meaning: Ranking: weighted BCE plus pairwise loss; single choice: cross entropy; multi-label: weighted BCE. Unjudged candidates are excluded from the loss.

trainer.meaning: Hugging Face Trainer; full tuning or PEFT LoRA; logs and resumable checkpoints.

devdata.meaning: Complete validation candidates and qrels; test data excluded.

selection.meaning: At epoch boundaries, nDCG@10 selects the best checkpoint using the complete dev split.

export.meaning: Final training weights always export. The best export additionally requires enabled ranking selection. Both preserve task, tokenizer, model specification and integrity manifest.

panels.meaning: Inference uses an exported model/task contract and unlabeled requests; only structured scores and IDs are returned.

request.meaning: Schema-validated query/context and candidates; labels are not required.

predictor.meaning: Verify and load artifact, then evaluate in no-grad mode and restore the previous train/eval state.

decision.meaning: Ranking sorts scores with optional threshold/TopK; single-choice takes the maximum with optional abstention; multi-label applies a logit threshold. Ties use stable ID order.

result.meaning: Structured scores, ranked_ids, selected_ids and policy metadata; consumed by an external Agent or workflow.

compressed: Token-level tensor operators and exact Qwen dimensions are covered by the separate tensor diagrams.
Checkpoint/resume and run logging are lifecycle annotations rather than additional computational nodes.
Artifact load metadata, batching and serialization internals are compressed into Predictor and exports.
validation_boundary: The real training cookbook is ranking with pairs/SDPA.
Dense tree is a correctness reference, not a validated sparse acceleration backend.
Ranking, single-choice and multi-label branches exist in source; quality-based full-dev selection currently supports ranking only.
